installCommand: [ -f ../../yarn.lock ] || { echo 'Vercel: enable "Include files outside the root directory in the Build Step" for this project'; exit 1; }; corepack yarn workspaces focus tldraw-nextjs-app-example @tldraw/monorepo config
buildCommand: cd ../.. && corepack yarn workspace tldraw prebuild && corepack yarn tsc --build packages/tldraw/tsconfig.json && corepack yarn workspace tldraw-nextjs-app-example build
